name: Makoto Inoue
description: Makoto Inoue is Protocol Lead at ENS Labs at ENS Labs, working on the Ethereum Name Service (ENS) since 2018. He has over two decades of experience building large-scale digital infrastructure across finance, insurance, and blockchain. Alongside his work in Ethereum, he is pursuing an MSc in Urban Analytics and AI, exploring how AI, machine learning, IoT, and open data can connect digital infrastructure with the physical world.
